# Paved plugin 3.3.0

Paved defaults to direct, outcome-focused work: the agent uses repository context and rules, runs applicable checks, and reports what it verified. Use governed intent, plan and execute workflows only when requested or required by project policy. A pinned project-local runtime provides CLI commands, declared Tools, verification and evidence. The local Workbench follows runs and recent Claude Code or Codex activity.

This directory is the installable plugin for Claude Code. It is generated by
`npm run build:plugin` in the Paved repository and must not be edited by hand.

- Plugin package version: `3.3.0`
- Runtime: `paved-core@3.3.0` unpacked at `runtime/paved-core/`; Claude Code installs its dependencies from `package-lock.json`.
- Runtime integrity: `sha512-G/6tMHC1NT9U9lnnA10SDRa5eKFbqmc7zPpagLzmt/78EYXr8ulOzW3aSafF43KmIy7MjOzYpwwg55Vkv6Fphw==`, checked over the runtime and its dependencies before activation
- Launcher: `scripts/paved.mjs`
- Lifecycle hooks: `hooks/hooks.json` adds a short session index and at turn end requests continuation when the changes have no passing recorded verification, without running checks itself, on supported, trusted hosts.
- Optional update helper: from an initialized project, explicitly run `node "<plugin>/scripts/paved.mjs" auto-update configure --host claude-code --mode auto --interval-hours 24 --json`; use `auto-update status --json`, `auto-update check --host <host> --json`, or configure `--mode off` / `--mode notify`. Defaults are off. SessionStart checks due updates only after explicit authorization; UserPromptSubmit is not used. Cursor remains manual.
- Workbench: `paved workbench start` opens the local run dashboard; optional lifecycle hooks show recent agent activity only while it is running.
- Skills: `/paved:<command>`

Installation and usage: https://github.com/andersonmrodrigues/paved/blob/main/docs/getting-started/installing-the-plugin.md
